description.value: A saddle embroidered with a purple worm carapace, adorned with ivory thorns and red and green ruffled drapes.
While this saddle is worn by a creature that runs on land, small lines of illusory spines emerge from the creature's wake and fade into the ground, like shark fins carving through the ocean's waves.

This gold amulet depicts an all-seeing eye surrounded by five gemstones. The central eye is a magical gem that becomes translucent when used, revealing wisps of shadowy figures mocking an unseen subject out of the wearer's periphery.

description.name: Seer's Vision
description.value: While wearing this amulet, you have darkvision out to 60 feet and can see invisible creatures and objects when you peer through the amulet's central gem. If you already have darkvision, using the amulet increases its range by 60 feet.
In addition, while wearing this amulet, you always know which way is north and the number of hours left before the next sunrise or sunset.

description.name: Spells
description.value: This amulet has 5 charges. As an action, you can hold the amulet over one of your eyes or your forehead and expend 1 charge to cast a spell from it (spell save DC 15). The spell cast is dependant on where you are holding the amulet:

• **Left Eye**: You cast the __legend lore__ spell, targeting one creature or object you can see.
• **Right Eye**: You cast the __scrying__ spell.
• **Forehead**: You cast the __divination__ spell.
The amulet regains 1d4 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn.

description.name: Curse
description.value: The amulet is cursed, and becoming attuned to the amulet extends the curse to you. The curse can only be broken by cleansing the amulet, but __remove curse__ or similar magic suppresses the curse for 24 hours. The amulet acts as a fulcrum and viewpoint to possible futures. Each possibility encompasses a self-contained reality similar yet different from another. Until the curse is broken, you gain the following flaw: "I regret the paths not taken, the other choices I could've made."
Until the curse is broken, whenever you cast a divination spell to gain information, the GM can ask you to roll a d20.

On an odd result of 17 or lower, the information or insight gained from the spell comes from an alternate reality with a worse outcome. When the GM gives these alternate readings, the readings should remain plausible with one or two major differences. For example, a __scrying__ spell cast over a keep reveals a ruined structure after a dragon attack, while the structure currently remains unharmed. On an even result of 18 or lower, the information or insight from the spell is plausibly true with only minor differences. For example, a __legend lore__ spell may reveal an object that once belonged to a king, when it actually belonged to a queen. On a roll of 19 or 20, the information or insight from the spell remains unaffected.
These boots resemble carved volcanic rock with glowing crimson veins. Chains wrap along the boots' calves, giving off a ghostly shimmer.

description.name: Heat Resistant
description.value: While wearing these boots, you have resistance to fire damage and can walk across hot liquid surfaces, such as lava, as if they were harmless ground. In addition, you can tolerate temperatures as high as 150 degrees Fahrenheit (66 degrees Celsius) without any additional protection. If you wear light or heat-resistant clothes, you can tolerate temperatures as high as 250 degrees Fahrenheit (121 degrees Celsius).

description.name: Ghostwalker
description.value: While wearing these boots, you can use an action to enter the Ethereal Plane as if under the effects of the __etherealness__ spell. You can use the boots to remain in the Ethereal Plane for up to 6 hours, all at once or in several shorter periods, each one using a minimum of 10 minutes from the duration. The boots regain 1 hour of their ability to traverse into the Ethereal Plane for every 4 hours they aren't in use or for every 50 points of fire damage dealt to you (after applying resistance).

description.name: Curse
description.value: The boots are cursed, and becoming attuned to the boots extends the curse to you; the boots' ghostly chains wrap around your spirit, preventing you from removing them. The curse can only be broken by cleansing the boots, but __remove curse__ or similar magic breaks the ghostly chains and allows you to remove the boots.

Until the curse is broken, whenever you enter the Ethereal Plane, you must succeed on a DC 11 Charisma saving throw or the boots banish you to a labyrinthine prison demiplane, while the boots remain in the space on the plane you entered the Ethereal Plane from. The DC increases by 1 for each successful saving throw and resets back to 11 on a failed saving throw. Once per hour, you can use an action to attempt to escape by making a DC 15 Intelligence check. On a success, you exit the prison demiplane and appear in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the boots. While trapped in the prison, you are constantly stalked by five hostile __chain devils__. If you die in the prison demiplane's maze, you return to life as a baleful __chain devil__ controlled by the GM until freed from the maze (see "Cleansing the Boots of Tartarus").
While wearing this ring in dim light or darkness, you can use an action to cast either the __minor illusion__ or __light__ cantrip from the ring at will.
Additionally, the ring has 6 charges for the following properties. The ring regains 1d6 expended charges daily at dawn.

description.name: Illusory Script
description.value: You can expend 1 charge as an action to cast the __illusory script__ spell from the ring.

description.name: Moon Shades
description.value: You can expend 2 charges as an action to cast the __mirror image__ spell from the ring.

description.name: Silver Bursts
description.value: You can expend 1 to 3 charges as an action. For each charge you expend, you manifest a glittering burst of silvery light at a point you can see within 60 feet of you. Each creature within a 5-foot cube originating from that point must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking **2d4** force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, a creature also glows silver until the end of your next turn, and the next attack made against the creature while it is glowing has advantage.

This scepter's handle is a long golden rod 22 inches in length. Atop the rod rests a large orb lined with a dozen different sparkling gemstones. Effigies of a lion, an eagle, a stag, and a dragon wrap around the orb, reaching for some unknown point above the rod. Upon closer inspection, shadowy visages spill through the specter's shaft.
The Scepter of the Unanointed is can be wielded as a magic mace that grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it.

description.name: Anointed Spells
description.value: While holding this rod, you can use an action to cast one of the following spells from it (save DC 17): __bless__, __death ward__, __lesser restoration__, or __protection from energy__. Once a spell has been cast using the rod, that spell can't be cast from it again until the next dawn or until you perform a charitable act, such as donating items to the less fortunate, volunteering at a religious site of worship, or helping a stranger in a meaningful way. The GM determines what is considered a charitable act, but it should involve a sacrifice of time, money, or other resources from you.

description.name: Devoted
description.value: While holding this rod, you have advantage on saving throws made to avoid being charmed or frightened. In addition, you have advantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain *concentration* on spells. You feel a sense of pious devotion and faith swell within you whenever you gain advantage on a saving throw thanks to the rod.

description.name: Sentience
description.value: Possessed by the demon Bernasatrix, the Scepter of the Unanointed is a sentient chaotic evil weapon with an Intelligence of 16, a Wisdom of 14, and a Charisma of 17. It has hearing and darkvision out to a range of 120 feet. Bernasatrix communicates telepathically with the rod's wielder and can speak, read, and understand Abyssal, Celestial, and Common. The demon presents themself as a benevolent spirit cursed and bound to the item by Arbalest in his final years.

description.name: Spellcasting Focus
description.value: If you are a cleric or paladin, you can use the scepter as a holy symbol, and you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your spells.

description.name: Virtue
description.value: While you hold this rod, it exudes a magical aura in a 15-foot-radius sphere that lets you know a creature's foremost virtue. Each creature of your choice who enters the aura's area for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there must make a DC 15 Charisma saving throw; the creature is aware of this effect on entering the aura and can choose to fail this saving throw. On a failed save, you learn the defining virtue (such as grace, humility, or peace) of that creature and have advantage on Wisdom (*Insight* and *Perception*) checks against them while they are in the aura. On a successful save, that creature is immune to this effect for 24 hours.

description.name: Curse
description.value: This rod is cursed with the vengeful spirit of a demon, and becoming attuned to it extends the curse to you. The curse can't be broken with __remove curse__ or similar magic, only by cleansing the item. Until the curse is broken, you are unwilling to part with the rod and gain the following flaw: "I know what I am doing, and I am always right. I know what's best for everyone."

Until the curse is broken, whenever you cast a spell using the rod's Anointed Spells property, roll a d20. On a 19 or 20, the spell is replaced with a detrimental effect for the spell's full duration, ignoring *concentration*:

• Targets of the __bless__ spell are treated as being under the __bane__ spell.
• A target of the __lesser restoration__ spell gains a level of exhaustion.
• A target of the __protection from energy__ spell gains vulnerability to the selected element instead of resistance.
• A target of the __death ward__ spell has disadvantage on death saving throws.
Attacks made with this weapon count as Unarmed Strikes, and you can use the Grapple option while holding this weapon.

description.name: Special
description.value: When you score a Critical Hit with this weapon, you can push the target up to 5 feet straight away from you. This stacks with the Push mastery property.

description.name: Light
description.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn and attack with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action later on the same turn. That extra attack must be made with a different Light weapon, and you don't add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage unless that modifier is negative. For example, you can attack with a Shortsword in one hand and a Dagger in the other using the Attack action and a Bonus Action, but you don't add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage roll of the Bonus Action unless that modifier is negative.

description.name: Push
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can push the creature up to 10 feet straight away from yourself if it is Large or smaller.

description.name: Mastery
description.value: If a feature grants you mastery with this armor, you gain the following benefits:

• You do not take fall damage unless you are incapacitated.
• While you are falling, you may activate (or deactivate) this cloak, with no action required. While active, your descent is slowed to 10 feet per round, and for every 10 feet you fall vertically, you can glide up to 20 feet in any horizontal direction you choose.
While wearing this cloak, you are protected from Extreme Cold and automatically succeed the saving throw required to avoid exhaustion.

description.name: Mastery
description.value: If a feature grants you mastery with this armor, you gain all the benefits from the Drifter's Cloak description. Additionally, during your turn you can fly up to 20 feet in any direction with no action required. After doing so, you must hit a target with a melee weapon attack—or end your turn while not airborne—before you can fly again.
Multiple variations of this item exist, as listed below:

• Bauble Trap (Uncommon)
• Bauble Trap (Rare)

These talismans are purpose-made to divert malicious spells from their intended subject and ensnare them for future use. It might take the form of a sealed jar of honey or wine, a complex stitching pattern, or a hollow pearl of rolled beeswax. Regardless of its design, a Bauble Trap always includes a strand of the protected subject's hair.

description.name: Thwart
description.value: The attuned creature adds 1d4 to its saving throws against spells of which it is the sole target. If it succeeds, the spell fails and has no effect, and is stored within the Bauble Trap, which loses this property.

description.name: Unleash
description.value: Thereafter, a creature that breaks the Bauble Trap  or is struck by it (as an improvised thrown weapon) releases the spell and becomes its new target. The Bauble Trap  is then destroyed.

An Uncommon Bauble Trap can hold a spell of level 5 or lower. A Rare Bauble Trap can hold a spell of any level. When creating a Bauble Trap, a witch can name a specific spell against which the saving throw bonus increases to 2d6.

While holding this book, you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus for your Witch spells, and you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your Witch spells.
In addition, you gain proficiency with one set of Artisan's Tools of your choice, and you can maintain 1 extra Witchcraft Tokens, if you create it using the chosen tools.

In addition, you gain proficiency with one set of Artisan's Tools of your choice, and you can maintain 1 extra Witchcraft Tokens, if you create it using the chosen tools.

name: Craftwork Grimoire (Very Rare)
type: very rare (requires attunement by a witch)

description.value: While holding this book, you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus for your Witch spells, and you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your Witch spells.
In addition, you gain proficiency with one set of Artisan's Tools of your choice, and you can maintain 1 extra Witchcraft Tokens, if you create it using the chosen tools.
This patchwork, quilted cloak smells faintly of hearth and home cooking. While wearing it, you gain the following benefits.

description.name: Cozy
description.value: You automatically succeed on saving throws against extreme cold and extreme heat, and the cloak keeps you dry unless you are immersed in water.

description.name: Focus
description.value: You can use the cloak as a Spellcasting Focus for your Witch spells.

description.name: Shelter
description.value: You can cast __Rope Trick__ with a duration of 8 hours. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.

• Hearth Keeper's Ladle (Uncommon)
• Hearth Keeper's Ladle (Rare)
• Hearth Keeper's Ladle (Very Rare)

While holding this ladle, you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus for your Witch spells, and you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your witch spells determined by the ladle's rarity.

In addition, as an action you can use the ladle to cast __Create Food and Water__. The food created in this way is a delicious soup or stew of your choice. Once the ladle is used to cast the spell, it can't do so again until the next dawn.

While holding this ladle, you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus for your Witch spells, and you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your witch spells determined by the ladle's rarity.

In addition, as an action you can use the ladle to cast __Create Food and Water__. The food created in this way is a delicious soup or stew of your choice. Once the ladle is used to cast the spell, it can't do so again until the next dawn.

name: Staff of the Coven
type: very rare (requires attunement by a druid or witch)

description.value: This Staff can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. While holding it, you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class, saving throws, and spell attack rolls.

The Staff has 20 Charges and regains 2d8 + 4 expended Charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last Charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the Staff retains its +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls but loses all other properties. On a 20, the Staff regains 1d8 + 2 Charges.

description.name: Spells
description.value: While holding the Staff, you can use a Magic action to cast one of the spells on the Staff of the Coven Spells table, using your spell save DC, spell attack bonus, and level. The table indicates how many Charges you must expend to cast the spell.

description.name: Punishing Curse
description.value: When a creature that you can see within 60 feet of you damages you or forces you to make a saving throw, you can take a Reaction to cast __Bestow Curse__ on the creature, ignoring the spell's normal range (paying its Charge cost as normal). When you cast the spell in this way, it doesn't require Concentration and has a duration of 1 minute, but ends early if you cast the spell again.

description.name: Versatile
description.value: A Versatile weapon can be used with one or two hands. A damage value in parentheses appears with the property. The weapon deals that damage when used with two hands to make a melee attack.

description.name: Topple
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus the ability modifier used to make the attack roll and your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, the creature has the Prone condition.

• Talon Athame (Rare)
• Talon Athame (Very Rare)

While holding this magic weapon, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it, and you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your Witch spells. In addition, you can use the weapon as a Spellcasting Focus for your Witch spells.
In addition, when you hit a creature with this weapon, you can expend and roll one Hit Die to deal extra Necrotic damage equal to the number rolled.

description.name: Finesse
description.value: When making an attack with a Finesse weapon, use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

description.name: Light
description.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn and attack with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action later on the same turn. For example, you can attack with a Shortsword in one hand and a Dagger in the other using the Attack action and a Bonus Action, but you don't add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage roll of the Bonus Action unless that modifier is negative.

description.name: Thrown
description.value: If a weapon has the Thrown property, you can throw the weapon to make a ranged attack, and you can draw that weapon as part of the attack. If the weapon is a Melee weapon, use the same ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls that you use for a melee attack with that weapon.

description.name: Nick
description.value: When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

This talisman usually takes the form of bottle chimes, a clapperless bell, or a similar noisemaker—but its humble form belies its clever anti-divinatory properties. The tocsin can be hung from a stable hook, branch, or peg with an action. Once it's set up, if a spell such as __Scrying__ or __Clairvoyance__ creates a sensor within 60 feet of the tocsin, it chimes, rings, squawks, or toots an alarm. The tocsin itself can't be seen or heard through such sensors.
Additionally, while a sensor remains open within range of the tocsin, the image of the spell's caster is visible as a dim reflection on the tocsin's surface.

Often a smooth, polished stone small enough to fit in one's pocket, these talismans may also take the form of small toys, beaded bracelets, or rings a half-size too loose. When you rub, fidget, or fiddle with this talisman for one minute during a Short or Long Rest, you can reroll an Intelligence check or a Wisdom (*Insight*) check that you made since the end of your last Short or Long Rest, even if the subject of the check is no longer at hand, and add 1d4 to the total. A given check can only be rerolled with the *Worry Stone* once.

name: Amber Birdcage

description.value: This birdcage, shaped from amber, physically replaces your torso while you are attuned to it. When your Attunement ends, it separates from you, and your torso returns to its previous state. The birdcage has the following properties.

description.name: Sense Fiends
description.value: As a Bonus Action, you can sense the location of Fiends or magical effects created by Fiends within 60 feet of yourself.

description.name: Capture Fiend
description.value: As a Magic action, choose one *Bloodied* Fiend that you can see within 60 feet of yourself. It must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be transformed into an amber songbird and trapped in the birdcage. The songbird is an inert object until removed from the cage and released. You can remove one songbird from the cage as a Bonus Action. If you stop holding the bird, the Fiend reverts to its true form with all its Hit Points, and it is Hostile to you.

description.name: Consume Songbird
description.value: As a Magic action, you can consume one amber songbird you are holding. The Fiend dies, and you can either regain one expended spell slot with a level up to half the Fiend's CR, or you can gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the Fiend's CR.

description.name: Amber Curse
description.value: You have a -1 penalty to Wisdom saving throws. Each time you use the Capture Fiend or Consume Songbird properties, this penalty increases by 1.

description.name: Lingering Curses
description.value: Ending your Attunement to one of these items removes its curse, but the power of a Cursed Curio doesn't release its hold on the user easily. If you attune to it again within 28 days, the progression of its curse returns to where it was before you ended your Attunement.

properties: ending your attunement to one of these items removes its curse, but the power of a cursed curio doesn't release its hold on the user easily. if you attune to it again within 28 days, the progression of its curse returns to where it was before you ended your attunement.

name: Axe of the Galloping Headsman (Legendary)

description.value: This axe has a wickedly curved head, honed to a razor's edge and lined with dark fire. It's handle is wrapped in cracked leather, and the entirety is etched with malevolent runes.
You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon determined by the axe's rarity. You can also use the following properties.

description.name: Fiery Smite (Rare+)
description.value: This axe deals an extra **1d6** Fire damage on a hit. If the target is a creature that damaged you since the end of your last turn, the extra damage becomes 1d10.

description.name: Mark of Guilt (Very Rare+)
description.value: When you hit a creature with the axe, you can mark it for punishment (no action required). You know the direction and distance to the creature. If it leaves this plane of existence, you know the destination plane and the mark ends. The mark otherwise ends when this property is used again, or when the target dies.

description.name: Sense Guilt (Very Rare+)
description.value: You can take a Bonus Action to hold the blade of the axe to a creature's neck (if it has one), and it must succeed on a Charisma saving throw (DC = 16 + the axe's bonus) or you learn something the creature feels guilty about. Once this property is used, the target is immune to it for 24 hours.

description.name: Dark Binding (Legendary)
description.value: Once during your turn when you hit a creature with the axe, you can immediately take a Bonus Action to force the target to succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or have the Paralyzed and Prone conditions until the start of your next turn. If its body shape allows it, the target kneels and presents its neck.

description.name: Executioner's Blade (Legendary)
description.value: When you attack a creature with the Prone condition using the axe, you score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20. On a Critical Hit, the axe deals an extra **3d6** Fire damage, and if the creature is left with 20 or fewer Hit Points after taking this damage, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or die.

description.name: Versatile
description.value: A Versatile weapon can be used with one or two hands. A damage value in parentheses appears with the property. The weapon deals that damage when used with two hands to make a melee attack.

description.name: Fabled Heirloom
description.value: Each Fabled Heirloom is a magic item that grows in strength as its attuned owner gains power. The rarity of each heirloom increases as the character grows in level, as shown on the Heirloom Rarity table. An heirloom's description details the properties it always has, as well as the properties it gains as it increases in rarity. The heirloom has all the properties of its rarity and lower.

name: Banjo of Ol' Jericho Sticks (Legendary)

description.value: An old, weathered banjo inscribed with runes, this instrument once belonged to Ol' Jericho Sticks, a scarecrow bard created by a hag coven.

While holding the banjo, you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus for your spells; you gain a +3 bonus determined by its rarity to spell attack rolls, your spell save DC, and Charisma (*Performance*) checks; and you can use the following properties.

description.name: Fiendish Lure (Rare+)
description.value: As a Magic action, choose one Fiend or Humanoid that you can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 16 + the banjo's bonus) or have the Charmed condition (ignoring a demon's Immunity) for 1 minute. The Charmed condition ends if you or your allies deal damage to the target or force it to make a saving throw. Once a creature is Charmed in this way, this property can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Scarecrow's Dance (Rare+)
description.value: You can take a Bonus Action to strum the banjo and dance wildly to take the Disengage action. The music is audible within 120 feet.

description.name: Join in the Dance (Very Rare+)
description.value: When you use Scarecrow's Dance, one creature of your choice that you can see within 15 feet of you can take a Reaction to move up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

description.name: Birdcage (Legendary)
description.value: As a Magic action, you can force a creature you have Charmed to make a DC 19 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature disappears, drawn into the banjo. The banjo can contain one creature at a time in this way for up to 24 hours. On a success, the Charmed condition ends on the creature.

name: Bell of the Dusk Mother (Legendary)

description.value: This heavy iron handbell is elaborately decorated with filigree. Its handle is a large ring, and its clapper hangs from a chain within. Its only sound is ever-mournful tolling.

While holding the bell, you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus for your spells, you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and your spell save DC determined by its rarity, and you can use the following properties.

description.name: Dolorous Tolling (Rare+)
description.value: As a Magic action, you can ring the bell, producing an ominous tolling. Creatures of your choice in a 30-foot Emanation originating from you must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 16 + the bell's bonus). On a failed save, a target takes **3d10** Psychic damage, and for 1 minute, when it makes an attack roll or saving throw, it must subtract 1d4 from the total. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Call of the Bell (Very Rare+)
description.value: You can take a Bonus Action to create a doll (use the __Animated Armor__ stat block) from a 5-foot Cube of wood, clay, or stone within 10 feet. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Death Knell (Legendary)
description.value: As a Magic action, you can ring the bell, creating a loud clang. Each *Bloodied* creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from you must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking **5d10** Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails the save by 5 or more drops to 0 Hit Points. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

name: Black Candle

description.value: This broad, black tallow candle is engraved with arcane symbols. When lit, its smoke is greasy and pungent, and its flame is pale gray, but it never burns down. The candle has the following properties.

description.name: Word of Flame and Darkness
description.value: As a Bonus Action, you can light or extinguish the candle by speaking a command word while within 60 feet of it. It sheds Dim Light in a 30-foot radius.

description.name: Witchlight
description.value: While you are in the candle's light, you can cast a level 1 or 2 spell without expending a spell slot. When you cast a spell in this way, you can't cast that spell using the candle again for 24 hours, and you must succeed on a DC 0 Constitution saving throw or take Fire damage equal to 2d6 times the spell's level.

description.name: Cursed Candle
description.value: After you succeed or fail on the saving throw of the Witchlight property, its save DC increases by 2. This increase can't happen again until you finish a Long Rest. When the DC is 10 or higher, you also have Vulnerability to Necrotic damage.

description.name: Lingering Curses
description.value: Ending your Attunement to one of these items removes its curse, but the power of a Cursed Curio doesn't release its hold on the user easily. If you attune to it again within 28 days, the progression of its curse returns to where it was before you ended your Attunement.

name: Bloody Fiddle

description.value: This scarlet-lacquered fiddle is warm to the touch, like the heat of fresh blood. Though it looks like it has seen better days, its sound is clear and strong.

description.name: Song of Stirred Blood
description.value: As a Magic action, you can play a lively or stirring tune on the fiddle. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Sanguine Curse

name: Blunderbuss of the Grinning Sinner (Legendary)

description.value: This dark, ornate blunderbuss has a brass barrel and a wooden handle etched with arcane symbols. It was the Grinning Sinner's weapon of choice, who imbued it with the power to shoot jinxes and hexes.

The blunderbuss functions as a Musket that ignores Loading, and it can make its own ammunition that deals Necrotic damage on a hit. You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it determined by the blunderbuss's rarity. While holding the blunderbuss, you can use the blunderbuss as a Spellcasting Focus for your spells, and you can use the following properties.

description.name: Jinxshot (Rare+)
description.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with a blast from the blunderbuss that forces each creature within a 30-foot Cone to make a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 16 + the blunderbuss's bonus), taking **2d4** Necrotic damage (Rare) or **3d6** Necrotic damage (Very Rare+) on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

description.name: Sinner's Jinx (Very Rare+)
description.value: Once during your turn when you damage a creature with the blunderbuss, the target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw (DC = 16 + the blunderbuss's bonus) or be cursed for 1 minute. When it makes a D20 Test while cursed, it subtracts 1d4 from the total. The curse ends if this property is used on another creature.

description.name: Luck Taker (Legendary)
description.value: When a creature you can see within 60 feet of you that is cursed by this weapon makes a D20 Test and rolls a 19 or 20 on the d20, you can take a Reaction to mimic their luck. The next time you make a D20 Test within 1 minute, change the number you roll on the d20 to the triggering number.

description.name: Range
description.value: A Range weapon has a range in parentheses after the Ammunition or Thrown property. The range lists two numbers. The first is the weapon's normal range in feet, and the second is the weapon's long range. When attacking a target beyond normal range, you have Disadvantage on the attack roll. You can't attack a target beyond the long range.

description.name: Ammunition
description.value: You can use a weapon that has the Ammunition property to make a ranged attack only if you have ammunition to fire from it. The type of ammunition required is specified with the weapon's range. Each attack expends one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition is part of the attack (you need a free hand to load a one-handed weapon). After a fight, you can spend 1 minute to recover half the ammunition (round down) you used in the fight; the rest is lost.

description.name: Two-Handed
description.value: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

The rarity of each heirloom increases as the character grows in level, as shown on the Heirloom Rarity table. An heirloom's description details the properties it always has, as well as the properties it gains as it increases in rarity. The heirloom has all the properties of its rarity and lower.

description.name: Slow
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the Speed reduction doesn't exceed 10 feet.

name: Cane of Phillip Druskenvald (Legendary)

description.value: This ornate cane is made from polished black wood and is topped with a silver goat-skull ornament. Even a glance at it sparks greed and envy in all but the truly humble.

While holding the cane, you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus for your spells, you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and your spell save DC determined by the cane's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

description.name: Eldritch Glutton (Rare+)
description.value: When you succeed on a saving throw against a spell that targets only you, you can take a Reaction to consume the spell and store its energy in the cane. The spell has no effect on you. You can take a Magic action to absorb the stored energy to either regain an expended spell slot that is at least one level lower than the triggering spell or gain Temporary Hit Points equal to three times the spell's level. If you absorb a new spell while the cane holds spell energy, the previous energy is lost. Once the cane absorbs a spell, this property can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Allure of Sin (Very Rare+)
description.value: You can cast __Dominate Person__ (save DC = 16 + the cane's bonus) from the cane. Once a creature is Charmed by the spell, this property can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Sin-Binder's Call (Legendary)
description.value: As a Magic action, you can summon three Hell Hounds, one Incubus, or one Succubus. They appear in unoccupied spaces you can see within 30 feet of you, obey your commands, and take their turns immediately after yours on your Initiative count. After 10 minutes, they no longer obey you, but if you treated them well, they are Indifferent or Friendly toward you. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

name: Cauldron of the Vermintoll Coven (Legendary)

description.value: The tarnished cauldron bubbles with a strange, dark liquid. Even in transport, the liquid stays within the rune-emblazoned rim of the cauldron.

While you hold the cauldron, you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus for your spells, you gain a +3 bonus determined by the cauldron's rarity to all saving throws, and you can use the following properties.

description.name: Size Change (Rare+)
description.value: You can perform a 1-minute ritual to change the cauldron's size from Tiny to Medium, or from Medium to Tiny. It weighs 1 lb. when Tiny and 80 lb. when Medium. As a Medium object, its feet can move. It has a Speed of 20 feet and moves when you command it during your turn (no action required).

description.name: Cookpot (Rare+)
description.value: As part of a Short or Long Rest, you can use the Medium cauldron to prepare food for up to ten creatures. At the end of the rest, each creature that eats gains 2d6 Temporary Hit Points.

description.name: Vermincall (Rare+)
description.value: As a Magic action, you can spill liquid from the cauldron to cast __Conjure Animals__ with it. The conjured spirits take the form of grotesque insects or rats. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Fortifying Gorge (Very Rare+)
description.value: When you use the Cookpot property, one creature of your choice who eats gains a +2 bonus to AC until you finish a Short or Long Rest. During this time, the creature's skin is hardened and monstrous.

description.name: Coven Abomination (Legendary)
description.value: As a Bonus Action, you can drink from the cauldron or administer a draught from it to a creature within 5 feet. For 1 hour, the drinker of the thick, sickly-sweet liquid becomes Large if it is currently smaller than that, its reach increases by 5 feet, and its melee attacks deal an extra **1d8** damage. When the effect ends, the creature has the Incapacitated condition for 1 minute from the agony of its bones shrinking slower than its flesh.

name: Chunk of Oozing Fungus

description.value: This fist-sized fungal growth is a pallid color, is oozy and lumpy, and frequently fills the air with spores. The fungus has the following properties.

description.name: Spore Cloud
description.value: As a Magic action, you can throw the fungus up to 30 feet. The fungus is destroyed and explodes into a cloud of spores in a 30-foot Sphere centered on that point. Each creature other than you in the area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes **3d8** Poison damage and has the Poisoned condition until the start of your next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more also has the Incapacitated condition. On a successful save, a target takes half damage only.

description.name: Regrow
description.value: You can grow another Chunk of Oozing Fungus by coughing green-black spores into your hand as a Bonus Action. When you do so, you must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or your Hit Point maximum decreases by 5.

description.name: Fungal Curse
description.value: You have a -1 penalty to Constitution saving throws. This penalty increases by 1 immediately after you succeed or fail on the saving throw from the Regrow property.

description.name: Lingering Curses
description.value: Ending your Attunement to one of these items removes its curse, but the power of a Cursed Curio doesn't release its hold on the user easily. If you attune to it again within 28 days, the progression of its curse returns to where it was before you ended your Attunement.

name: Crown of the Barrow King (Legendary)

description.value: This crown of twisted iron has five sharp, tall spikes that are crusted with dried blood. None who see it doubt the malice and corruption that the Barrow King imbued into it.

While you wear the crown, you gain a +3 bonus determined by the crown's rarity to spell attack rolls and to your spell save DC for Necromancy spells and spells that deal Necrotic damage, and you can use the following properties.

description.name: Demand of the Dead (Rare+)
description.value: You can cast __Speak with Dead__ from the crown.

description.name: Grave Grasp (Rare+)
description.value: You know the __Chill Touch__ cantrip. Your spell attack bonus with it is +9 (Rare), +10 (Very Rare), or +11 (Legendary).

description.name: Necromancer's Call (Rare+)
description.value: You can cast __Animate Dead__ from the crown. It can be used to cast this spell three times, regaining all expended uses daily at dusk.

description.name: Master of Undeath (Very Rare+)
description.value: Undead that you create or summon have twice as many Hit Points as normal and have Advantage on saving throws.

description.name: Soul Transfer (Very Rare+)
description.value: When you drop to 0 Hit Points or fail a Death Saving Throw, you can transfer your soul into an Undead that you created and that is within 1 mile of you (no action required). Your previous body dies instantly. Your new body has none of your possessions except the crown. You use your game statistics, except the target Undead's current Hit Points replace your current Hit Points. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Compel Undead (Legendary)
description.value: As a Magic action, you can choose an Undead within 30 feet of you. It must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for 1 minute. It obeys your commands while Charmed in this way, and the condition ends early when the creature is *Bloodied*.

name: Cutlass of Briggsy Kratch (Legendary)

description.value: A fearsome weapon imbued with jinxcraft magic, this cutlass was once wielded by the notorious pirate captain, Briggsy "The Kutlass" Kratch. Its tarnished blade glimmers with a faint, otherworldly light. A skull and crossbones adorn the leather-wrapped hilt, and arcane symbols etched into the blade pulse with hidden power.
You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with the cutlass determined by its rarity. While holding the cutlass, you can use the following properties.

description.name: Raise the Stakes (Rare+)
description.value: As a Bonus Action, choose a creature within 5 feet of you and mark it until the start of your next turn. Count the number of times you hit the target and the number of times it hits you while the mark lasts. If you hit the target more times, it takes **2d10** Psychic damage. If it hits you more times, you take **2d10** Psychic damage. If your hits are tied, you both take **2d10** Psychic damage. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Sea Legs (Rare+)
description.value: When you take the Disengage action, Difficult Terrain doesn't cost you extra movement until the end of that turn.

description.name: Double Down (Very Rare+)
description.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can make one additional attack against a target marked by the Raise the Stakes property.

description.name: Jinxcraft Panache (Very Rare+)
description.value: When a creature hits you with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to increase your AC against that attack by twice the cutlass's bonus to attack and damage rolls if the creature already dealt damage to you on this turn.

description.name: Hex Ward (Legendary)
description.value: You can't be targeted with Divination spells or perceived through magical scrying sensors, and a creature that curses you takes Psychic damage equal to your level.

description.name: Finesse
description.value: When making an attack with a Finesse weapon, use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

description.name: Light
description.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn and attack with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action later on the same turn. That extra attack must be made with a different Light weapon, and you don't add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage unless that modifier is negative. For example, you can attack with a Shortsword in one hand and a Dagger in the other using the Attack action and a Bonus Action, but you don't add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage roll of the Bonus Action unless that modifier is negative.

description.name: Fabled Heirloom
description.value: Each Fabled Heirloom is a magic item that grows in strength as its attuned owner gains power. The rarity of each heirloom increases as the character grows in level, as shown on the Heirloom Rarity table. An heirloom's description details the properties it always has, as well as the properties it gains as it increases in rarity. The heirloom has all the properties of its rarity and lower.

description.name: Nick
description.value: When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

description.value: When you take the Disengage action, Difficult Terrain doesn't cost you extra movement until the end of that turn.

description.name: Double Down (Very Rare+)
description.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can make one additional attack against a target marked by the Raise the Stakes property.

description.name: Jinxcraft Panache (Very Rare+)
description.value: When a creature hits you with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to increase your AC against that attack by twice the cutlass's bonus to attack and damage rolls if the creature already dealt damage to you on this turn.

description.name: Finesse
description.value: When making an attack with a Finesse weapon, use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

description.name: Light
description.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn and attack with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action later on the same turn. That extra attack must be made with a different Light weapon, and you don't add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage unless that modifier is negative. For example, you can attack with a Shortsword in one hand and a Dagger in the other using the Attack action and a Bonus Action, but you don't add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage roll of the Bonus Action unless that modifier is negative.

description.name: Fabled Heirloom
description.value: Each Fabled Heirloom is a magic item that grows in strength as its attuned owner gains power. The rarity of each heirloom increases as the character grows in level, as shown on the Heirloom Rarity table. An heirloom's description details the properties it always has, as well as the properties it gains as it increases in rarity. The heirloom has all the properties of its rarity and lower.

description.name: Nick
description.value: When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

name: Devilbone Button

description.value: This bone button is found on an article of clothing, such as a shirt or coat, and is carved with the tiny image of a devil. It must be attached to clothing that you wear to attune to it. You gain a +1 bonus to saving throws, and it has the following properties.

description.name: Improbable Luck
description.value: When you fail a saving throw while wearing the button, you can choose to succeed instead. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Protective Bone
description.value: While wearing the button, your Hit Point maximum increases by 5 + your Constitution modifier.

description.name: Diabolic Curse
description.value: When you finish a Long Rest, there is a 1 percent chance the button is mysteriously missing and your Attunement to it ends. A devil with a CR of your level + 3 or CR 20 (whichever is lower) then becomes your enemy and seeks to destroy you. The GM determines the devil's details. When you use the Improbable Luck property, the chance the button disappears increases by 1.

description.name: Lingering Curses
description.value: Ending your Attunement to one of these items removes its curse, but the power of a Cursed Curio doesn't release its hold on the user easily. If you attune to it again within 28 days, the progression of its curse returns to where it was before you ended your Attunement.

description.value: When you drink this potion, you gain a ravenous thirst for blood and gain the effect of the __Vampiric Touch__ spell (level 6 version, no *Concentration* required) for 1 minute. You can repeat the attack on subsequent turns as a Bonus Action instead of a Magic action.
This liquid is a shimmering red deeper and more intense than natural blood.

description.name: Heightened Potency
description.value: For the duration, as a Magic action, you can gain the effects of the __Gaseous Form__ spell (no *Concentration* required) while you aren't in sunlight. You can also revert to your normal form as a Magic action.

When you drink this potion, your breath billows out in clouds of fog. For the next 10 minutes, fog and smoke don't hinder your vision, you can cast __Fog Cloud__ up to three times (no *Concentration* required), and you can cast __Misty Step__ up to three times as long as your teleportation begins or ends in an area of fog. This bottle has a base like cobblestone. The glass widens near the top before narrowing again into an iron cap, resembling a lantern. The liquid inside is a murky gray.

description.name: Heightened Potency
description.value: The potion's duration becomes 1 hour, and when you use this potion to cast __Misty Step__, you also gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage until the start of your next turn.

name: Eye of the White Worm (Legendary)

description.value: This fist-sized eyeball is cold and clammy to the touch. It is milky-white with purple veins, and its pupil constantly searches for something.

While holding the eye, you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus for your spells, you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and your spell save DC determined by the eye's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

description.name: Thought Scour (Rare+)
description.value: You can cast __Detect Thoughts__ (save DC = 16 + the eye's bonus) from the eye. When you probe deeper into a creature's mind, it takes **3d8** Psychic damage unless it is a willing target. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Mnemonic Siphon (Very Rare+)
description.value: You can cast __Modify Memory__ (save DC = 16 + the eye's bonus) from the eye. When you do, you gain a version of the affected memory as if you experienced it yourself, though you still know the memory isn't yours. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Violation of the Real (Very Rare+)
description.value: When you cast a Conjuration spell using a spell slot that deals damage, or that summons a creature that can deal damage, the spell or creature deals an extra **1d10** Psychic damage to one target the first time it deals damage during a turn.

description.name: Enduring Violation (Legendary)
description.value: When you cast a Conjuration spell with a duration of 1 hour or more, you can extend the duration to 24 hours, and the spell no longer requires *Concentration*. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

name: Green Ribbon

description.value: This green satin ribbon is just long enough to fasten around a person's neck comfortably. It's hard to think why you'd even want to remove it. While you wear the ribbon, you have a +5 bonus to Death Saving Throws, and it grants the following properties.

description.name: Instant Attunement
description.value: If the ribbon is wrapped around the neck of a dead creature that has been dead no longer than 10 days and wasn't Undead when it died, the creature returns to life as if by a __Raise Dead__ spell, and it instantly attunes to the ribbon. The creature dies immediately if its Attunement to the ribbon ends or if the ribbon is removed.

description.name: Ribbon's Mending
description.value: When you drop to 0 Hit Points, you can take a Reaction to immediately regain Hit Points equal to half your level (minimum 1). Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk or until you roll a 20 on the d20 for a Death Saving Throw.

description.name: Curse of the Ribbon
description.value: Creatures other than you within 60 feet of you have a -1 penalty to Death Saving Throws. This penalty increases by 1 each time you use the Ribbon's Mending property.

description.name: Lingering Curses
description.value: Ending your Attunement to one of these items removes its curse, but the power of a Cursed Curio doesn't release its hold on the user easily. If you attune to it again within 28 days, the progression of its curse returns to where it was before you ended your Attunement.

description.value: When you drink from this glass jug, you become insubstantial for 1 minute. During this time, you can move through creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain, taking **1d10** Force damage if you end your turn inside an object.
The potion is stored in jugs labeled "XxX," with a skeletal smile drawn on it. The ghastly, blue-green liquor within has an overpowering smell and harsh taste.

description.name: Heightened Potency
description.value: For the duration, you gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed.

When you drink this potion, you are filled with good health and bounty, providing you with enough nourishment to sustain you for 1 day. For the next hour, when you regain Hit Points, you regain additional Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
The potion's bottle is made from a hollowed-out gourd, and the thick, liquid inside is a deep orange that tastes of nutmeg and cardamom.

description.name: Heightened Potency
description.value: The additional Hit Points you regain are equal to half your level rather than your Proficiency Bonus (minimum +2).

name: Hide of the Brimstone Behemoth (Legendary)

description.value: This cloak was made from the hide of a reptilian magma Fiend, incomparable in its destructive power. Flame now shies away from it, for one who has mastered such a titanic creature can master its element.
While wearing this cloak, you gain a +3 bonus to Armor Class and Constitution saving throws determined by the cloak's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

description.name: Deep-Dweller (Rare+)
description.value: You have Resistance to Fire damage and a Burrow Speed equal to your Speed. Once during your turn when you emerge from burrowing, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from you must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 16 + the hide's bonus), taking **2d8** Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

description.name: Infernal Roar (Rare+)
description.value: You can cast __Fear__ (save DC = 16 + the hide's bonus) from the cloak. This property can be used three times, regaining all expended uses daily at dusk.

description.name: Hellfire Maw (Very Rare+)
description.value: As a Magic action, you can exhale hellfire in a 30-foot Cone. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 16 + the hide's bonus). On a failed save, a creature takes **4d6** Fire damage and **4d6** Necrotic damage, and it can't regain Hit Points for 1 minute. On a successful save, it takes half damage only. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Pernicious Fire Immunity (Legendary)
description.value: Fire actively avoids you. You have Immunity to Fire damage. When you are the target of an attack that deals Fire damage, the attack randomly targets another creature within the attack's range, which can include the attacker. When you make a saving throw against an effect that deals Fire damage, you must choose one other creature that is also making the saving throw against that effect. It has Disadvantage on the save.

An heirloom's description details the properties it always has, as well as the properties it gains as it increases in rarity. The heirloom has all the properties of its rarity and lower.

name: Hook of the Tall Man (Legendary)

description.value: This hook is made from a single huge claw attached to a large bleached fingerbone mounted on a haft of ash. The tip of the claw gives off an eerie glow. The finger and claw were cut from the hand of the Tall Man.
You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon determined by the hook's rarity. While holding the hook, you can use the following properties.

description.name: Snare (Rare+)
description.value: When you hit a creature with the hook, you can activate the __Topple__ mastery property in addition to a different mastery property you're using with it.

description.name: Fey Haunt's Stride (Rare+)
description.value: You can cast __Misty Step__ from the hook, and when you do so, you have Advantage on your next Dexterity (*Stealth*) check made before the end of your next turn. This property can be used twice, regaining all expended uses when you roll Initiative.

description.name: Strike from Shadows (Very Rare+)
description.value: When you start your turn with the Invisible condition, you have Advantage on the first attack you make on your turn, even if the condition ends before you make the attack. If that attack hits, it deals an extra **2d6** Piercing damage.

description.name: Hunter's Hook (Legendary)
description.value: When you hit with an Opportunity Attack made with the hook, the target takes an extra **2d6** Psychic damage, and its Speed is 0 until the end of the turn.

description.name: Terrifying Stride (Legendary)
description.value: Immediately after you use the Fey Haunt's Stride property, you can choose a creature within 20 feet of you. It must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn. While Frightened in this way, the creature can't take the Disengage action.

description.name: Versatile
description.value: A Versatile weapon can be used with one or two hands. A damage value in parentheses appears with the property. The weapon deals that damage when used with two hands to make a melee attack.

description.name: Hypnovulfen Eye
description.value: While holding the figure, you can cast __Confusion__ (save DC 14) with it. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

name: Idol of the Beast of Blight (Legendary)

description.value: Made of bleached and mutated bone, this idol in the shape of a stag contains the sinister knowledge of the Beast of Blight. It pulses with the power of rot and decay.

While holding the idol, you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus for your spells, you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and your spell save DC determined by the idol's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

description.name: Rotting Touch (Rare+)
description.value: You can use your Strength, Dexterity, or Wisdom modifier for the attack and damage rolls of your Unarmed Strikes, and on a hit, your strike deals an extra **1d6** Necrotic damage (Rare), **1d8** Necrotic damage (Very Rare), or **1d10** Necrotic damage (Legendary).

description.name: Touch of Oblivion (Rare+)
description.value: As a Bonus Action, you can touch a creature that has been dead for less than 1 hour. It rots away to bleached bone and can't be used for this property again. The next time you hit with an Unarmed Strike using the Rotting Touch property before the end of your next turn, it is a Critical Hit instead.

description.name: Hallucinatory Spores (Very Rare+)
description.value: When you cast a spell using a spell slot or from the idol, you can choose one creature that you can see within 10 feet of you. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 16 + the idol's bonus) or take **2d6** Psychic damage and have Disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn.

description.name: Rot in the Flesh (Very Rare+)
description.value: You can cast __Barkskin__ from the idol targeting only yourself. For the duration, a creature that hits you with a melee attack roll takes **1d8** Necrotic damage. Once the spell is cast from the idol, it can't be cast from it again until the next dusk.

description.name: Hollow with Rot (Legendary)
description.value: When you regain Hit Points from a spell, you also gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the spell's level.

description.name: Fabled Heirloom
description.value: Each Fabled Heirloom is a magic item that grows in strength as its attuned owner gains power. The rarity of each heirloom increases as the character grows in level, as shown on the Heirloom Rarity table. An heirloom's description details the properties it always has, as well as the properties it gains as it increases in rarity. The heirloom has all the properties of its rarity and lower.

name: Jinxed Poker Chip

description.value: This ceramic poker chip is painted with a crocodile's skull on one side. Hoarse laughter sounds when it flips. While you hold the chip, it grants the following properties.

description.name: Jinxed Luck
description.value: When you fail a D20 Test, you can take a Reaction to flip the chip. Roll 1d6. On a 4-6, you succeed on the D20 Test instead. After you use this property, roll 1d20. On a 1-5, this property can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Sense Cheating
description.value: If you have proficiency with a Gaming Set, you automatically succeed on ability checks to know if someone in a game you are playing is cheating.

description.name: Cursed Coin
description.value: When you roll Initiative, you must succeed on a DC 0 Charisma saving throw or become cursed until you finish a Short or Long Rest. While cursed, you subtract 1d6 from D20 Tests. When you use the Jinxed Luck property, the saving throw DC increases by 1.

description.name: Lingering Curses
description.value: Ending your Attunement to one of these items removes its curse, but the power of a Cursed Curio doesn't release its hold on the user easily. If you attune to it again within 28 days, the progression of its curse returns to where it was before you ended your Attunement.

description.value: When you drink this brightly colored rum, your luck takes a strange turn for 1 hour. For the duration, when you make a D20 Test, roll 1d4. On a 2-4, add the number to your roll. On a 1, roll an extra d20 and use the lowest roll for the test.
This potion is stored in a glass rum bottle marked with crossbones.

description.name: Heightened Potency
description.value: Roll 1d6 instead of 1d4.

name: Lantern of the Chained Reaper (Legendary)

description.value: This ornate Hooded Lantern was once a weapon in the hands of the Chained Reaper, filled with ghastly balefire. Able to pierce the veil, the lantern reveals a glimpse at things hidden from mortal eyes.

While you hold the lantern and it is lit, you gain a +3 bonus to Intelligence (*Investigation*) and Wisdom (*Perception*) checks determined by the lantern's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

description.name: Ghostly Flame (Rare+)
description.value: The lantern doesn't require fuel, and it sheds blue-green light. It casts Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet. You can snuff or ignite its light as a Bonus Action while you are within 30 feet of it.

description.name: Revealing Flame (Rare+)
description.value: Creatures in the Border Ethereal within the area of the lantern's Bright Light are visible to creatures on the Material Plane. When a creature within the lantern's Bright Light is possessed or affected by the __Magic Jar__ spell, the creature in control appears overlaid on the body in a spectral form.

description.name: Mystic Sight (Very Rare+)
description.value: You can cast __Detect Magic__ from the lantern. The spell ends early if you extinguish the light or aren't holding the lantern.

description.name: Summon Spirit (Very Rare+)
description.value: As a Magic action, you can summon a __Ghost__ that appears in an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of you. The ghost obeys your commands, and it takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count. The ghost vanishes after 1 minute, or when it dies. You can't use the lantern's properties, except for Ghostly Flame, during this time.

description.name: Balefire (Legendary)
description.value: You can cast __Scorching Ray__ (level 5 version, +11 to hit) from the lantern. This property can be used three times, regaining all expended uses daily at dusk.

description.name: Warding Light (Legendary)
description.value: The lantern's area of Bright Light offers the protection of a __Magic Circle__ spell. This protection can't operate in the reverse direction, and it ends if you aren't holding the lantern or if you have the Incapacitated condition.

An heirloom's description details the properties it always has, as well as the properties it gains as it increases in rarity. The heirloom has all the properties of its rarity and lower.

description.value: When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the __Polymorph__ spell (no *Concentration* required), turning you into a Frog.
This potion is found in a clay jar shaped and painted like a large frog, with a cork stopper in its back.

description.name: Heightened Potency
description.value: The potion has six doses instead of one.

name: Marotte of the Lord of Fools (Legendary)

description.value: This wooden fool's scepter is painted with vibrant, unsettling colors that depict a grinning face. While no creature is attuned to the marotte, the face looks like the infamous Chuckles, the Lord of Fools.

While holding the marotte, you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus for your spells, you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and your spell save DC determined by the marotte's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

description.name: Coulrophobia (Rare+)
description.value: When you succeed on a saving throw to avoid the Frightened condition, you can take a Reaction to force the creature that created the effect to make the same saving throw. On a failed save, it has the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn.

description.name: Fortune's Fool (Rare+)
description.value: You can cast __Tasha's Hideous Laughter__ (save DC = 16 + the marotte's bonus) from the marotte. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk. You regain use of the spell early if you roll a 1 on the d20 for a D20 Test.

description.name: Fool's Motley (Very Rare+)
description.value: You can cast __False Life__ from the marotte. Any clothing or armor you wear looks like a fool's motley for the duration of the spell.

description.name: Slapstick (Very Rare+)
description.value: When a creature is affected by a __Tasha's Hideous Laughter__ spell you cast, you can choose another creature. When that creature deals damage to the target of the spell, the target has Disadvantage rather than Advantage on its saving throw to end the spell.

description.name: Lord of Fools (Legendary)
description.value: You can cast __Mass Suggestion__ (save DC 19) from the marotte. The effect ends on a creature if it is behind Total Cover or more than 120 feet from you. A creature affected by your __Tasha's Hideous Laughter__ automatically fails its saving throw against this Mass Suggestion. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.value: Each Fabled Heirloom is a magic item that grows in strength as its attuned owner gains power. name: Mask of Lethica Nightborne (Legendary)

description.value: This immaculate porcelain mask is painted with delicate violet filigree and once belonged to Lethica Nightborne—a priestess of a goddess of night and healing known as the Nightmother.
While wearing the mask, you gain a +3 bonus to Wisdom and Charisma saving throws determined by the mask's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

description.name: Gift of the Night Goddess (Rare+)
description.value: You can see normally in magical and nonmagical Dim Light and Darkness.

description.name: Soothing Darkness (Rare+)
description.value: Creatures of your choice in the area of a __Darkness__ spell that you cast have Resistance to Psychic damage.

description.name: Whispers of Night (Rare+)
description.value: You can cast __Darkness__ from the mask. This property can be used twice (Very Rare+: four times), regaining all expended uses daily at dusk.

description.name: Balm of Midnight (Very Rare+)
description.value: At the start of your turn, a Frightened creature of your choice within 60 feet of you must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the condition ends, and if the creature is in an area of Darkness, it gains 2d10 Temporary Hit Points.

description.name: Offering of Burdens (Legendary)
description.value: As a Magic action, you can touch a willing creature with Exhaustion levels and transfer any number of Exhaustion levels to yourself, then remove up to two Exhaustion levels from yourself and regain one expended spell slot of level 5 or lower. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Surcease of Sorrows (Legendary)
description.value: You can cast __Modify Memory__ from the mask (save DC 19). If the target voluntarily fails the saving throw, you can choose a memory that happened at any time in its lifespan. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

name: Midwife Shears

description.value: These scissors are shaped to resemble a stork. Their blades are forever wickedly sharp, and the threads they cut are more than merely physical.

description.name: Cut the Unseen Thread
description.value: While holding the scissors, you can cast __Dispel Magic__ (+4 bonus) or __Remove Curse__ from them. Once either spell is cast from the scissors, that spell can't be cast from them again until the next dusk.

description.name: Curse of the Severed Thread
description.value: When you make a saving throw to avoid being pushed or to avoid the Prone condition, you have a -1 penalty to the roll. This penalty increases by 1 each time you use the Cut the Unseen Thread property. If you fail such a save by 5 or more, you are pushed 1d6 x 5 feet straight away from the source of the save, in addition to any other distance pushed.

description.name: Lingering Curses
description.value: Ending your Attunement to one of these items removes its curse, but the power of a Cursed Curio doesn't release its hold on the user easily. If you attune to it again within 28 days, the progression of its curse returns to where it was before you ended your Attunement.

description.value: When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the Commune with *Nature* spell, but your experience is filled with terror and dread. You must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, for the next 8 hours, you have Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks while you can see a forest. You automatically succeed on the save if you have Immunity to the Frightened condition.
This bottle is carved from wood, with a green, leafy face adorning its surface. The liquid is a deep green streaked with shades of umber.

description.name: Heightened Potency
description.value: You can learn all five facts from Commune with *Nature*.
When you drink this potion, you have Darkvision out to 120 feet for the next 24 hours. During that time, you don't need to sleep, and if you take a Long Rest, you can remain conscious throughout.
This clay bottle with a waxed stopper is painted with the head of a great horned owl, and the liquid within is midnight blue

description.name: Heightened Potency
description.value: The duration increases to 72 hours.

name: Planchette of Adela Druskenvald (Legendary)

description.value: A small, heart-shaped silver pointer hangs from a silver necklace. It is inscribed with occult symbols. When placed on an open book or other assortment of letters, the air nearby feels heavy and cold.

While wearing the planchette, you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus for your spells, you gain a +3 bonus to Intelligence and Wisdom ability checks determined by the planchette's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

description.name: Sense the Unseen (Rare+)
description.value: The planchette has 5 charges and regains 1d4 + 1 expended charges daily at dusk. You can expend charges to cast the following spells from it: __Detect Magic__ (1 charge), __Locate Object__ (2 charges), __See Invisibility__ (2 charges).

description.name: Starlight Ward (Rare+)
description.value: You have Resistance to Radiant damage. When you take Radiant damage, for the next minute, the star-sigils on the planchette shed Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.

description.name: Vision Beyond (Very Rare+)
description.value: The planchette now has 9 charges and regains 1d8 + 1 expended charges daily at dusk. You can also cast __Find Traps__ (2 charges) and __Sending__ (3 charges) from it.

description.name: Spirit Ward (Very Rare+)
description.value: When you fail a saving throw against the __Magic Jar__ spell or possession (such as by a __ghost__), you can expend 3 charges to succeed instead.

description.name: Third Eye Opened (Legendary)
description.value: The planchette now has 13 charges and regains 1d12 + 1 expended charges daily at dusk. You can also cast __Divination__ (4 charges), __Contact Other Plane__ (5 charges), and __Etherealness__ (7 charges) from it.

description.name: Fabled Heirloom
description.value: Each Fabled Heirloom is a magic item that grows in strength as its attuned owner gains power. The rarity of each heirloom increases as the character grows in level, as shown on the Heirloom Rarity table. An heirloom's description details the properties it always has, as well as the properties it gains as it increases in rarity. The heirloom has all the properties of its rarity and lower.

description.value: When you drink this potion, you are filled with intense and violent vigor, gaining 3d8 Temporary Hit Points. For 1 minute, when one of your enemies dies within 30 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to regain 1d8 Hit Points.
The base of this glass potion bottle is shaped like a skull, and the images of scythes run up its neck.

description.name: Heightened Potency
description.value: For 1 minute after drinking this potion, when you hit a *Bloodied* creature with an attack roll and deal damage to it, the creature takes an extra **1d8** Necrotic damage.

name: Revelry Suit

description.value: This bulky suit is made from natural materials, including fur, canvas, and straw. Its mask is exceptionally oversized and shaped into a sun, smiling in an unsettling way. While you wear this armor, you gain a +2 bonus to AC, and it grants the following properties.

description.name: Dancing Dodge
description.value: When you fail a Dexterity saving throw, if your Speed isn't 0, you can use this property to succeed instead. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Wild Steps
description.value: As a Bonus Action, you can move up to your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

description.name: Dancing Curse
description.value: When you roll Initiative, you must make a DC 0 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you gain the Incapacitated condition, and your Speed is 0 until the start of your next turn as you perform a folk dance. When you use the Dancing Dodge or Wild Steps properties, the DC of the saving throw increases by 2. The DC of this curse can't increase again until you finish a Long Rest.

description.name: Lingering Curses
description.value: Ending your Attunement to one of these items removes its curse, but the power of a Cursed Curio doesn't release its hold on the user easily. If you attune to it again within 28 days, the progression of its curse returns to where it was before you ended your Attunement.

name: Runestone of the Wild Titan (Legendary)

description.value: This mighty granite runestone is etched with complex glyphs on much of its angular surface. Though an incredible burden to carry, it thrums with the power of the wild titan. The stone weighs 50 pounds.
While holding the stone, you gain a +3 bonus to Strength and Constitution saving throws determined by the runestone's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

description.name: Crushing Weight (Rare+)
description.value: When you are within 5 feet of a creature with the Prone condition, you can take a Bonus Action to set the stone on the creature to give it the Restrained condition. The creature can take an action to make a Strength saving throw (DC = 16 + the stone's bonus), pushing the stone free and ending the Restrained condition on a success.

description.name: Boulder Throw (Very Rare+)
description.value: You can throw the stone as a Simple Ranged weapon using Strength for the attack and damage rolls. The stone has the Heavy and Thrown properties. It has a normal range equal to twice your Strength score and a long range equal to five times your Strength score. On a hit, it deals **2d10** Bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC = 16 + the stone's bonus) or have the Prone condition.

description.name: Recall (Very Rare+)
description.value: As a Bonus Action, you can call the stone back to you, provided it is within 1 mile. If you have an empty hand, it appears in your hand; otherwise, it appears at your feet in your space.

description.name: Primal Vitality (Legendary)
description.value: While you stand on fertile soil or unworked stone, you have Advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws, and you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to 2d6 + your Strength modifier at the start of each of your turns.

description.name: Pummeling Boulder (Legendary)
description.value: The damage of the Boulder Throw property increases to 3d10, and the stone deals double damage to objects and structures.

description.name: Fabled Heirloom
description.value: Each Fabled Heirloom is a magic item that grows in strength as its attuned owner gains power.
