you don't add your ability modifier to the weapon's damage, unless otherwise stated. firearm ammunition is destroyed upon use.

description.value: A bolt of magic lightning surges around inside this glass canister, casting Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.

When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing the Bottled Lightning. Target one creature or object you can see within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or take **2d8** Lightning damage and be unable to make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

name: Bounty Hunter's Carbine

description.value: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

description.name: Tracker
description.value: When you hit a creature with an attack using the carbine, you can mark the target for 24 hours. While the creature is marked and it and the blaster are on the same plane of existence, the blaster beeps intermittently to indicate the target's distance to you. This mark ends if the creature dies or you mark a different creature.

description.name: Nonlethal
description.value: When you reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points using this weapon, you can instead knock the target out, as you would with a Melee weapon.

description.name: Magic Item Set
description.value: If you are carrying this carbine and wearing a Bounty Hunter's Vest, you can disarm your target with a well-placed shot. When you hit a creature with an attack using the carbine and exceed the target's AC by 5 or more or score a Critical Hit, the target makes a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it drops an object of your choice that it's holding, which lands at its feet.

description.name: Range
description.value: A Range weapon has a range in parentheses after the Ammunition or Thrown property. The range lists two numbers. The first is the weapon's normal range in feet, and the second is the weapon's long range. When attacking a target beyond normal range, you have Disadvantage on the attack roll. You can't attack a target beyond the long range.

description.name: Blaster
description.value: A weapon with the Blaster property is a Ranged weapon that requires no ammunition. This property counts as Ammunition.

description.name: Firearm
description.value: You don't add your ability modifier to the weapon's damage, unless otherwise stated. Firearm ammunition is destroyed upon use.

description.name: Two-Handed
description.value: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

description.name: Slow
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the Speed reduction doesn't exceed 10 feet.

properties: a weapon with the blaster property is a ranged weapon that requires no ammunition. this property counts as ammunition.
you don't add your ability modifier to the weapon's damage, unless otherwise stated. firearm ammunition is destroyed upon use.

description.value: When you drink this potion, you can breathe underwater or in the vacuum of space for 8 hours. The potion also protects you from extreme temperatures and pressures.

When you drink this potion, your body casts Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet for the next hour. The light is sunlight. Until this duration ends, you can use a Bonus Action on your turn to deal **1d8** Radiant damage to each creature within the Bright Light. Its liquid is an opaque silver and glows brightly when shaken.

This capsule, large enough to fit one Medium or smaller creature, can provide air and heat for its occupant indefinitely. A creature inside the pod can set a duration ranging from one month to 1,000 years and activate the pod as a Utilize action. The pod then locks and cryogenically freezes the creature and the rest of the pod's contents over the course of a minute. A frozen creature has the Unconscious condition, doesn't age, and doesn't need air, food, or water. When the duration expires, the pod deactivates, thawing the creature and the pod's contents over the course of a minute. The pod then unlocks.
If a creature fails to set a duration on the pod, it remains frozen until another creature takes a Utilize action to deactivate and unlock the pod.

This 1-inch long drive can store arbitrarily large amounts of data, including text, images, and video. Over the course of a minute, you can transfer information between a Data Drive and an Arcane Terminal, Datapad, or similar computer. You can only upload or download information you have access to; certain information may be encrypted and be accessible only to authorized users. Information stored on a Data Drive can't be directly read without a device like a Datapad that has an interface.

This flat, rectangular device can perform countless personal computing tasks. For example, a Datapad can take text notes, view downloaded data, transfer credits to and from the Galactic Bank, and interface with other devices.

Datapads can interface with one another and Arcane Terminals within a range of 1 mile. Users can communicate with each other using text, audio, or video, and search the contents of any connected Arcane Terminal. Typically, Arcane Terminals on populated worlds are connected together in planetary networks ("nets") which allow a user to comb through a vast, encyclopedic collection of knowledge and provide connection between any two users across the planet.

This two-handed beam weapon has 3 charges and regains all expended charges daily at dawn. When you take the Attack action, you can expend 1 charge to replace one of your attacks with a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long Line in a direction you choose. Each creature in the Line makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking **3d8** Radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

description.name: Upgraded Magic Item
description.value: If you have proficiency in Martial weapons, this item grows in power as you do. The item's save DC increases when you reach level 5 (DC 15), 11 (DC 17), and 17 (DC 18).

Activating this egg-shaped device as an action creates a dome of force centered on the projector as if you had cast the __Geodesic Shield__ spell. When the spell ends, the projector burns out and becomes nonmagical.
By grasping the two handles on this foot-wide steering wheel, you can cast the __Speedcycle__ spell. The motorcycle materializes beneath you and attaches to the steering wheel.
Once you use this item to cast the __Speedcycle__ spell, it can't be used again until the following dawn.

This Datapad is enchanted to hold an incredible wealth of information. However, the data isn't indexed, so the Encyclopedia only provides data that it believes will be useful at any given moment. The Encyclopedia 3 charges, and regains all charges daily at dawn. When you take the Study action, you can expend 1 charge to access the Encyclopedia and gain a +20 to any Intelligence checks you make as a part of that action.

An essential tool for galactic communication, an Etheradio transmits and receives its messages though the Ethereal Plane. This device stands over 6 feet tall (with an antenna that extends its length by an additional 3 feet) and weighs 1,000 pounds.

description.name: Transmitting
description.value: An operator can use the device as a Utilize action to transmit an audio message of up to 10 minutes to a specific Etheradio on the same plane of existence or to an etheradio station. Hundreds of stations exist, many of them earmarked for specific uses, such as streaming music or government communications. By broadcasting on an emergency station, an Etheradio can transmit a message to all other Etheradios on the same plane of existence, but it can only send such a message once per day. No matter the distance, messages take 10 minutes to reach their destination.

description.name: Receiving
description.value: The Etheradio stores the most recent 10 hours of audio it has directly received. An operator can use the device as a Utilize action to listen to stored audio or to tune into an Etheradio station.

description.name: Calibration
description.value: An Etheradio only works if it is calibrated according to its location in the universe. Calibrating this device takes 1 hour, and it must be recalibrated if it is ever moved more than 100 miles. Calibration takes into account regular cosmic motion, such as a planet's orbit.
This two-handed nozzle, connected to a backpack of arcane batteries, has 7 charges and regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn.

When you take the Attack action, you can replace one or more of your attacks with a 15-foot Cone of fire from the Flamethrower, expending 1 charge for each attack replaced in this way. Each creature in that area makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking **3d6** Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

description.name: Upgraded Magic Item
description.value: If you have proficiency in Martial weapons, this item grows in power as you do. The item's save DC increases when you reach level 5 (DC 15), 11 (DC 17), and 17 (DC 18).

This antique camera is loaded with a roll of film containing 1d6 + 2 blank photos. You can use a Magic action to take a picture using the camera, casting the __Flashback__ spell. The developed photo depicts the events that the spell has altered. When all of the camera's photos have been taken, it ceases to be magical.

This scaled-down Datapad is packed with dozens of digital amusements and diversions that test a user's reflexes and puzzle-solving skills. If you spend a Short Rest playing on this Gamestation, you gain Advantage on the next ability check you make before you finish a Short or Long Rest.

This crystalline fragment of pure hardlight has 6 charges and regains 1d6 expended charges daily at dawn. Whenever you make a D20 Test, you can expend a number of charges up to your proficiency bonus and add that number to the number rolled on the d20, to a maximum of 20. If you use the fragment to improve an attack roll that deals damage, you can change the damage type to Force.

description.name: Magic Item Set
description.value: Attuning to multiple Gamma Fragments counts as being attuned to a single item. Add the charges into a single pool that regains 1d6 expended charges for each fragment daily at dawn.

You can attach this fist-sized device to an object weighing less than 2,000 pounds as a Magic action, nullifying the object's mass as if it were targeted by the __Levitate__ spell. The nullifier functions for 10 minutes, after which it burns out and permanently ceases to function. If the object is still aloft, it gently floats to the ground.

This magic bracer has 20 charges. You can expend 1 charge as a Magic action to produce a Hardlight Dart to your open hand. If unused, this dart evaporates into light after 24 hours. The bracer regains 1d10 + 5 charges daily at dawn.

When the button set into the top of this small, faceted orb is pressed as a Magic action, holo-emitters generate a translucent humanoid figure, which the orb floats inside. This figure functions identically to the __Unseen Servant__ spell, though it is visible (with an appearance determined by the creator).

As a Magic action, you can activate this 6-inch wide Sphere and deploy it within 15 feet of you. The sphere then captures a holographic recording of the events that occur within a 15-foot Emanation centered on it. The cube can record for a total of 5 minutes. You can pause recording, delete a recorded scene, or play back a recorded scene as a Magic action.

The holo-recording can be played back at full-size or at a miniaturized 1-foot scale. However, the presence of magic interferes with the recording process, and high volumes of magic may reduce the playback to an unrecognizable holographic mess.

This 3-foot-long metal board produces a low hum and curiously hovers over any surface. You can ride the board or dismount it as a Bonus Action. While riding the board, your Speed increases by 10 feet, you ignore Difficult Terrain, and can move above the surface of liquids without sinking. The board can't scale an incline greater than 45 degrees unless it is in a zero-gravity environment.
You can use your choice of a Dexterity (*Acrobatics*) check or a Charisma (*Performance*) check to perform tricks on the board.

This limited-edition can of Krash-branded energy drink was discontinued decades ago for being too extreme (as well as for hazardous side effects from its magical additives). When you drink this potion, a jittery feeling rushes to your extremities. You can take an additional action this turn, which can be used to take only the Attack (one attack only), Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Utilize action. You also have Advantage on all attack rolls and ability checks you make until the end of this turn. The feeling of energy is then replaced by lethargy, and you can't gain the benefits of this potion again for 1 hour.

Rather than drinking this vial of orange, brackish liquid, you inject into your body as a Bonus Action. Once injected, for 1 hour, your Strength and Dexterity scores each increase by 2, to a maximum of 22. You must also succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or suffer a negative reaction; you are reduced to 0 Hit Points, fall unconscious, and can't regain Hit Points for 1 hour.

You can use up to three doses of Jax at once as a part of the same Bonus Action. Each additional dose you take further increases your Strength and Dexterity scores, up to a maximum of 26. For each dose beyond the first, the Constitution saving throw DC increases by 5, to a maximum of 25.

This device is a miniature version of the impulse engines used in starships, and has been fitted with straps and a small handheld controller. It has 4 charges and regains 1d4 expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing it on your back, you can take a Magic action and expend 1 charge, gaining a Fly Speed equal to your Speed for 10 minutes.

This one-piece jumpsuit comes equipped with a domed glass helmet. While wearing it, you can breathe underwater or in the vacuum of space for up to 24 hours at a time. The suit also protects you from extreme temperatures and pressures (see the Glossary), inhaled poisons and gasses, and contagions. You can wear the suit underneath a suit of armor. To replenish its air supply, the suit must be removed for 2 hours.

This scanner bears an illuminated screen on one side. While holding it, you can determine the location of any creatures or objects within 60 feet of you that have moved since the end of your last turn, even if they have the Invisible condition or have Total Cover from you. A creature that has the Hide action's Invisible condition, however, avoids detection by the tracker.

This capsule contains a swarm of short-lived nanobots designed to destroy, repair, or amass together into a creature. The nanobots come in three varieties: Deconstructive, Reconstructive, and Transformative. All three sets of nanobots are indistinguishable; you can determine the capsule's contents with a DC 15 Intelligence (*Technology*) check.

You can take the Magic action to open and throw the canister. Target one creature, object, or unoccupied space within 30 feet of yourself. If the canister is thrown at an unoccupied space, the nanobots cover a 5-foot-square area. The effect is determined by the type of nanobots.

description.name: Deconstructive Nanobots
description.value: The target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be covered with nanobots. At the start of each of its turns, a target covered with the nanobots takes **1d10** Necrotic damage which ignores Resistance and Immunity. After 1 minute, the nanobots deactivate permanently.

This capsule contains a swarm of short-lived nanobots designed to destroy, repair, or amass together into a creature. The nanobots come in three varieties: Deconstructive, Reconstructive, and Transformative. All three sets of nanobots are indistinguishable; you can determine the capsule's contents with a DC 15 Intelligence (*Technology*) check.

You can take the Magic action to open and throw the canister. Target one creature, object, or unoccupied space within 30 feet of yourself. If the canister is thrown at an unoccupied space, the nanobots cover a 5-foot-square area. The effect is determined by the type of nanobots.

description.name: Reconstructive Nanobots
description.value: The target is covered in nanobots. At the start of each of its turns, the target regains 1d6 Hit Points. After 1 minute, the nanobots deactivate permanently.

This capsule contains a swarm of short-lived nanobots designed to destroy, repair, or amass together into a creature. The nanobots come in three varieties: Deconstructive, Reconstructive, and Transformative. All three sets of nanobots are indistinguishable; you can determine the capsule's contents with a DC 15 Intelligence (*Technology*) check.

You can take the Magic action to open and throw the canister. Target one creature, object, or unoccupied space within 30 feet of yourself. If the canister is thrown at an unoccupied space, the nanobots cover a 5-foot-square area. The effect is determined by the type of nanobots.

description.name: Transformative Nanobots
description.value: The nanobots assemble into a Nanite Swarm at the point of impact. The swarm is friendly to you and your companions, understands your languages, and obeys your spoken commands. If you issue no commands, the swarm takes the Dodge action and moves to avoid danger. After 8 hours, or after the nanite swarm drops to 0 Hit Points, the nanites deactivate.

This interconnected array of devices can be installed in a Fighter-sized ship with 1 hour of work. Once the apparatus is installed, the fighter can be deployed and piloted remotely from a controller unit included with the apparatus. The controller relays visual and sensor information from the fighter and allows a character using it to enter the Dogfighter ship role. If the ship strays more than 10 miles from the controller, it loses connection and falls dormant until the controller unit is within signal range.
While wearing this ring, you can use a Magic action to expend 1 of its 3 charges to cast the spell __Paradox__ from it. The ring becomes nonmagical when you use the last charge.

While attuned to this ring, you can breathe underwater or in the vacuum of space. The ring also protects you from extreme temperatures and pressures (see the Glossary). Additionally, in zero-gravity environments, you gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed.

This device, worn over one eye, has 3 charges and regains all expended charges daily at dawn. As a Bonus Action, you can press a button on the device and expend 1 charge to analyze a creature you can see within 60 feet. You learn two of the following pieces of information: the target's Armor Class, current Hit Points, its Immunities, its Resistances, its Vulnerabilities, or  any spells that currently affect the target.

This device emits a shimmering field of magical force around you, protecting you from a single blow. You can activate this device as a Bonus Action. The next attack made against you within the next hour has a -10 penalty to hit. Then, the emitter must recharge and can't be used again until the next dawn.

This apparatus is worn on the back and produces a shoulder-mounted cannon above your left shoulder when you speak the command word as a Magic action. Once activated, the cannon makes an attack at the start of each of your turns (no action required) against the nearest enemy it can see within 60 feet of you. The cannon has a +9 attack bonus and deals **3d8** Force damage on a hit. The cannon has Darkvision and Thermalsight with a range of 120 feet, and can see Invisible creatures.

The cannon remains active for 1 minute. If you are Incapacitated or die, the cannon remains active until the end of its duration. Once activated, the cannon can't be activated again until the next dawn.

This stripped-down Dark Matter engine has been retrofitted to launch miniature black holes with the pull of a trigger. This device has 5 charges and regains 1d4 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. While holding it, you can use a Magic action and expend 1 or more of its charges to cast the __Gravity Well__ spell (save DC 15) from it. For 1 charge, you cast the 3rd-level version of the spell. You can increase the spell slot level by one for each additional charge you expend.

This black keycard, emblazoned with a white skull, is imbued with magic that can unlock any door. As a Magic action, you can use this keycard on any door which could be hacked, such as those on a ship, even if such a door doesn't have a keycard reader. The door becomes unlocked, as if targeted by the __Knock__ spell, and opens.

While wearing this cloak in an area of Bright Light, you can take a Magic action to speak its command word. This transforms the cloak into a pair of radiant wings on your back until you dismiss them (no action required). The wings give you a Fly Speed of 60 feet. If you are no longer in Bright Light, you lose this Fly Speed.

description.name: Magic Item Set
description.value: Attuning to these wings and an Ankh of Ra and a Heretical Sunstaff of Ra counts as being attuned to a single item. If you are attuned to the wings and one of these items, you can use the wings to cast the spell __Daylight__ at will without using a spell slot.

The Sorting Beast is a six-legged machine with eyes, legs, and antennae at both ends, as well as an array of measuring devices near its center. It can manipulate and hold objects up to 30 pounds in weight. When activated as a Magic action, the Sorting Beast sets about collecting and sorting all loose valuable items within 100 feet. It sorts all Gold Pieces, Silver Pieces, and Copper Pieces into neat stacks of 10. For material goods, such as precious stones, the machine can appraise value by weight and quality before sorting the goods appropriately and printing the results on a fine paper strip. The machine continues sorting until finished or deactivated (no action required). Additionally, the Sorting Beast can cast the spell __Identify__, without using material components, on an object you designate. Once it casts __Identify__, it can't do so again until the next dawn.

When you throw this oblong metal container as a Magic action, it unfolds into a Mechanical Spider (see Monsters chapter for statistics). Your spider acts independently of you, but it always obeys your commands. In combat, it takes its turn immediately before or after your turn each round (your choice). If the spider drops to 0 Hit Points, it can't be repaired. You can collapse the spider back down into its pod as a Magic action. You can only have 3 spiders under your control at any time.

This extraordinary machine, standing 40 feet tall and bearing great smokestacks, can transmute materials and balance a planet's atmosphere to support life. The engine can be activated or deactivated with 1 hour of work. If set down on a Tier 4 or higher planet, activated, and allowed to process the planet's water, atmosphere, and soil for a year, the engine lowers the planet's Tier by 1. The engine has no effect on a Tier 1 or Tier X world, and two terraforming engines can't lower a planet's Tier by more than 1 (though multiple engines might provide redundancy, should one fail). If the engine is deactivated or removed from the planet, the planet degrades to its original condition over the course of 7 days.

This handheld device, a necessity for distant voyages, translates any spoken language. While holding it, you can understand any spoken language you hear. Moreover, when you communicate by speaking or signing, any creature that knows at least one language and can hear the speech or see the signing can understand you.

This beacon transmits an ultra-high frequency signal through the Void, allowing it to be detected tens of thousands of light-years away. This signal consists of the beacon's current coordinates and a short message of up to 16 characters (spaces count as characters). This message can manually be changed as a Magic action. Once activated, the beacon repeatedly transmits its signal for 7 days and then burns out permanently.

This device, a bracer with an affixed rotary dial and several buttons lining its circumference, is connected to nine small extradimensional spaces. While wearing this bracer, you can use a Magic action to deposit any weapon or object you are holding that weighs no more than 100 pounds and can fit into a 10-foot cube into one of the extradimensional spaces, linking that item to the wheel. The wheel can be linked to up to 9 items at a time, one in each extradimensional space. You can use a Magic action to unlink an item from the wheel.

Once on each of your turns (no action required), you can teleport one of the wheel's linked items to your hand. Doing so also causes any other items linked to the wheel to return their extradimensional spaces.

You've installed a secondary pair of arms beneath your normal arms. These arms are fully functional and can be used to hold weapons and shields (allowing you to wield two Two-Handed weapons, or four one-handed weapons), perform Somatic components of spells, and perform other actions, though the arms themselves don't grant you any additional actions or body slots for grafts.

Once installed, this mechanical skin and musculature makes you indistinguishable from a human. Your other grafts aren't visible while this graft is installed. Each Android Skin is modeled after an existing human, living or dead, and dozens of Android Skins exist.
With a pure gemstone crystal at its core, the Arcane Resonator installed in your body can synchronize with a magic item, allowing you to attune to up to four magic items at once.

You have stolen a bit of arcane potential by inserting additional nerves into your brain. You learn one cantrip of your choice from the Wizard spell list. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this cantrip when you cast it with this graft (choose each time you install this graft).

Once installed, this device preserves your memories, allowing you to recall anything you have seen or heard while it is installed with perfect clarity. This device is incredibly resilient, and will remain intact despite otherwise catastrophic damage to your body. A Black Box's memories can be recovered with a DC 15 Intelligence (*Technology*) check; a failure permanently corrupts the data. The data is also corrupted if it is installed in a new host.
These memories can be reviewed on a Datapad, Arcane Terminal, or similar computer. They can also be uploaded to a new body or a Personality Module using the __Transfer Consciousness__ spell.
You have installed a device that allows you to cling to surfaces and move with agility on walls and ceilings. You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.
Your Climbing Apparatus might resemble a set of peripheral limbs, magnetic attractors, or a grapple-hook-launching mechanism.

Folded into your back when not in use, these silver, mechanical wings grant you a Fly Speed equal to your Speed. You can deploy or retract these wings as a Bonus Action. Additionally, you can deploy the wings as a Reaction while you are falling.

Your body houses a secondary mechanical mind  to assist in arcane focus. Whenever you make a Constitution saving throw to maintain *Concentration* on a spell, you can add your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier (your choice when you install this graft), to the roll instead of your Constitution modifier.

Your base Armor Class equals 13 plus your Dexterity modifier. You can wear armor on top of your Embedded Armor, and you can use either armor to determine your AC. You can use a Shield and still gain this benefit.

You replace one of your hands with an imposing, articulated gauntlet, a Battlefist. While this weapon is installed, you are proficient with it and can't be disarmed of it. The Battlefist can hold and manipulate objects, though you can't attack with a Battlefist while holding an object with it.

Emitters in the fingertips can produce a set of razor-sharp Laser Claws. Whenever you would normally be able to draw a weapon, you can transform one or both of your hands into a set of Laser Claws, and you can revert them to their normal forms when you could normally stow a weapon. While this graft is installed, you are proficient with these weapons and can't be disarmed of them. You can't hold or otherwise manipulate a weapon, Shield, or other object with a hand that is transformed.
This convenient insulated box in your abdomen can store and chill up to six cans of Krash, potions, or similar beverages.

One of your hands is mechanical and can transform into a Repeater. Whenever you would normally be able to draw a weapon, you can transform your hand into a Repeater, and you can revert it to its normal form when you could normally stow a weapon.

While this graft is installed, you are proficient with this weapon and can't be disarmed of it. You can't hold or otherwise manipulate a weapon, Shield, or other object with a hand that is transformed.
You have a Universal Translator magic item installed within your skull and can use it at will.

Deep within your body, you have installed a miniature Arcane Warhead, whose trigger is linked to your life. When you die, this bomb detonates and destroys your body completely; as a result, you can be restored to life only by means of a __True Resurrection__ or __Wish__ spell. Each creature within a 180-foot radius Sphere centered on your body makes a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. Creatures within a 60-foot radius that have Evasion or a similar feature can't avoid this damage. On a failed save, a creature takes 1d4 Mega (1d4 × 100) Force damage, or half as much on a successful save.

Your mechanical hand has a retractable set of Thieves' Tools built directly into the fingers. You can extend or retract these tools as a Bonus Action. While retracted, you can conceal them perfectly. You have proficiency with Thieves' Tools while the picks are installed. If you already have proficiency, your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses them.

Your arms have been replaced with the oversized limbs of a golem or a similar Construct. Your reach is 5 feet greater whenever you make an attack with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike. Additionally, you have Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws.
Your newly-installed fingers can plug directly into machines and subdivide into smaller digits for faster typing. While installed, this graft counts as having an Interface Rig.

When you fail an attempt to hack a device, you can use this graft to reroll it, potentially turning failure into success. You must use the new roll, and you can't use this graft to reroll again until you finish a Long Rest.

You have replaced your heart with an automaton's construct core. You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a motionless state, during which you retain consciousness.

You have installed a mechanical exoskeleton, rooted in your legs. You can use your Bonus Action to kick a creature of Large size or smaller within 5 feet of you. Make an Unarmed Strike. On a hit, the target is pushed 5 feet away from you.
You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

You have installed thrusters into your legs and back. Once on each of your turns, when you move at least 15 feet in a straight Line, you can move up to 10 additional feet in that direction without spending movement. Alternatively, you can spend 10 feet of movement to jump 10 feet vertically.
You have replaced your eyes with sensors that can see in the dark. You gain Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

You've installed a defibrillator, or a similar piece of technology, into your vital organs. If you are dead or have 0 Hit Points at the start of your turn, the unit jolts you back to life with a surge of electricity. You revive with 1 Hit Point. This graft can't revive you if you lack a heart, have died of old age, or are missing vital organs.
Once this graft activates, it can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

Your brain has been augmented with an algorithmic processing unit. You can add half your Proficiency Bonus (round down), to any Intelligence ability check you make that uses a skill proficiency you lack and doesn't already include your Proficiency Bonus. Additionally, you know Machine Code (DarkMatter24), the native code-language of machines. Due to this language, you know the __Technomancy__ cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the feat).

You have installed an internal generator to temporarily accelerate your reaction speed. You can use a Bonus Action to fire up your Overdrive Module. For the next minute, time appears to move in slow motion. When you activate this graft and as a Bonus Action on subsequent turns, you gain Advantage on the next attack roll or ability check you make before the end of your turn. Additionally, you can use your Reaction to gain Advantage on a Dexterity saving throw or to impose Disadvantage on an attack made against you by a creature you can see.
Once you activate this graft, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

A Personality Module contains a neural trace of someone's entire personality: their core memories, manner of speaking, likes and dislikes, and even skills. While this module is installed, you are proficient in two skills, know two languages, and have a personality trait inherent to the personality. Each Personality Module offers a different set of skills, languages, and personality traits, according to whom it was modeled after.

You have replaced one of your eyes with a spherical mechanical replacement, which you can remove or insert as a Bonus Action. Even while the eye is removed, you can see whatever it sees as long as you are within 120 feet of it. The eye can look in every direction, but it can't move on its own.

One or more of your organs or limbs has been interchanged with an efficient mechanical version. A Replacement can replace an amputated limb or missing organ but can't revive a creature that has died. Replacement limbs can look like the original limb, or can appear metallic or mechanical. A Replacement organ or limb takes up one body slot relevant to it; for example, a robotic hand takes the Arms slot and a replacement kidney takes up the Internal slot. You can have more than one Replacement in a single body slot.
You can cast the __Shield__ spell once using this graft without a spell slot. Once you activate this graft, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

Shock-absorbing coils in your legs let you bound higher and cushion your landings. The distance of your Long and High Jumps increases by 10 feet (this extra distance costs movement as normal). You suffer no penalty for making a standing High or Long Jump.
You can take a Reaction when you fall to reduce any damage you take from the fall by an amount equal to five times your Proficiency Bonus.

This graft creates a zone of breathable air, allowing you to breathe underwater or the vacuum of space. The graft also protects you from extreme temperatures and pressures. Additionally, in zero-gravity environments, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed.

Whenever you would normally be able to draw a weapon, you can collapse your mechanical hand into your forearm with a flick of the wrist, extending a wide blade in its place. You can revert your hand to its normal form whenever you could normally stow a weapon. While this graft is installed, you are proficient with this weapon and can't be disarmed of it. You can't hold or otherwise manipulate a weapon, Shield, or other object with a hand that is transformed.

description.name: Finesse
description.value: When making an attack with a Finesse weapon, use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

description.name: Vex
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to the creature, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

name: Arm Cannon

description.value: One of your arms is replaced wholesale with a powerful blaster cannon. While this graft is installed, you are proficient with this weapon and can't be disarmed of it. This arm cannon lacks any hand or manipulator, so you can't manipulate a weapon, Shield, or other object with that hand while the cannon is installed.

description.name: Blaster
description.value: A weapon with the Blaster property is a Ranged weapon that requires no ammunition. This property counts as Ammunition.

description.name: Firearm
description.value: You don't add your ability modifier to the weapon's damage, unless otherwise stated. Firearm ammunition is destroyed upon use.

description.name: Slow
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the Speed reduction doesn't exceed 10 feet.

properties: a weapon with the blaster property is a ranged weapon that requires no ammunition. this property counts as ammunition.
you don't add your ability modifier to the weapon's damage, unless otherwise stated. firearm ammunition is destroyed upon use.

name: Laser Eyes

description.value: One or both of your eyes have been replaced with powerful laser emitters, blasters hidden in your pupils. You are proficient with this weapon and can't be disarmed of it. You can't use this weapon if you have the Blinded condition.

you don't add your ability modifier to the weapon's damage, unless otherwise stated. firearm ammunition is destroyed upon use.

description.value: This subdermal graft redirects a specific type of elemental energy. You have Resistance to one type of damage while this graft is installed. The GM chooses the type or determines it randomly from the options below.

This mechanical skin conceals thousands of razor sharp spikes, which you can extend at a moment's notice. When a creature you can see within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, you can use your
Reaction to deal **1d4** Piercing damage to that creature. The damage increases by 1d4 when you reach level 5 (2d4), 11 (3d4), and 17 (4d4).
You have augmented your eyes with sensors that detect heat. You gain Thermalsight with a range of 30 feet.

You have plating installed into your body, resembling a suit of armor. Your base Armor Class equals 17 (your Dexterity modifier doesn't affect this number). You can wear armor on top of your Titan Armor, and you can use either armor to determine your AC. You can use a Shield and still gain this benefit.
Retractable spikes in your legs allow you to ignore Difficult Terrain. Additionally, you have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid the Prone condition.

Your vocal cords have been replaced with an electronic modulator, allowing you to change the pitch, tone, and characteristics of your voice at will. You can unerringly mimic any voice or sound you have heard, and you can augment your voice with synthetic effects, such as reverb.

The holsters on this vest lead to an extradimensional space capable of perfectly concealing two blasters and a Melee weapon. A weapon stored in the extradimensional space can be drawn at a moment's notice, even outside of your turn, without using a Reaction.

description.name: Magic Item Set
description.value: If you are wearing this vest and carrying a Bounty Hunter's Carbine, you can treat the result of your Initiative rolls as 10, or your character level plus your Dexterity modifier, whichever is higher.

name: Brass Repeater

description.value: When you hit a target with this weapon and roll the same number on two or more different damage dice, you can add your Dexterity modifier to the damage roll.

description.name: Upgraded Magic Item
description.value: This weapon grows in power as you do. When you reach character level 5, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. This bonus increases by +1 at level 11 (+2) and level 17 (+3).

description.name: Range
description.value: A Range weapon has a range in parentheses after the Ammunition or Thrown property. The range lists two numbers. The first is the weapon's normal range in feet, and the second is the weapon's long range. When attacking a target beyond normal range, you have Disadvantage on the attack roll. You can't attack a target beyond the long range.

description.name: Blaster
description.value: A weapon with the Blaster property is a Ranged weapon that requires no ammunition. This property counts as Ammunition.

description.value: This spherical device, dotted with blinking lights, explodes in a wave of concussive force. You can take the Utilize action to throw this grenade up to 30 feet. At the start of your next turn, the grenade detonates in a 10-foot-radius Sphere. The grenade has AC 13 and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage; it detonates immediately if it takes damage after it is thrown. Each creature within the area makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes **6d6** Thunder damage and has the Deafened condition for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage and doesn't have the Deafened condition.

description.name: Chain Reaction
description.value: If one or more Concussion Grenades that aren't being worn or carried are within the blast radius of a Concussion Grenade when it detonates, all of the grenades detonate simultaneously in a chain reaction. The Thunder damage increases by 1d6 and the blast radius increases by 5 feet for each grenade, up to a maximum of 10d6 and a 30-foot-radius Sphere.

The enormous frame, which weighs in excess of 2,000 pounds, seems less like a suit of armor and more like a mechanized, bipedal vehicle. You don't need armor training to wear this armor. You can don and doff it as a Utilize action by traveling through a series of hatches on the front of the suit. You gain the following benefits while wearing the armor.

description.name: Armor Class
description.value: While wearing this armor, your Armor Class equals 18 (your Dexterity modifier doesn't affect this number). You can use a Shield and still gain this benefit.

description.name: Size
description.value: Your size becomes Large, if it was smaller.

description.name: Mighty
description.value: You have Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws.

description.name: Integrated Battlefists
description.value: The frame has two integrated Battlefists. While wearing the armor, you have proficiency with these weapons.

description.name: Life Suit
description.value: The frame confers the benefits of a Life Suit.

As a Utilize action, you can throw this spherical device up to 30 feet, which detonates in a 10-foot-radius Sphere a moment after impact. Each creature within the Sphere must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or have the Blinded and Deafened conditions until the start of your next turn. A creature that shields its eyes and ears automatically succeeds on this saving throw.

This shoulder-mounted cannon fires heat-seeking missiles designed to penetrate a ship's hull. As a Magic action, you can lock onto a ship or Mega-sized creature you can see within 2,000 feet. The launcher loses its lock on a target if the target moves more than 2,000 feet away from you or takes Evasive Maneuvers. Once locked onto a target, you can use a Magic action on a subsequent turn to fire the missile. Make a ranged spell attack with a +9 bonus. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 Mega Necrotic damage.

This elaborate mod contains an integrated Construct that can adjust your aim on the fly. This mod has 5 charges and regains 1d4 + 1 charges daily at dawn. When you make a ranged attack using this blaster, you can expend 1 charge for the Aimbot to attack on your behalf; you forgo rolling the d20 to get a 10 on the die. If the roll has Advantage or Disadvantage, the 10 replaces only one of the two dice, and you roll the other d20 as normal.

While this battery is installed, this blaster deals Necrotic damage instead of its normal damage type, and the target's Hit Point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage it took. The creature dies if this effect reduces its Hit Point maximum to 0.

When you make a ranged attack with this blaster, you can activate the Beam Module on the weapon's barrel to focus the shot into a 5-foot wide Line that extends out to the weapon's normal range. Each creature in that Line makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes the weapon's normal damage plus an extra **2d6** Radiant damage, or half as much damage on a successful one. The blaster then Overheats; an overheated weapon can't be used again to make an attack until the end of your next turn. Once you use this mod, you can't use it again until the next dawn.
While this barrel attachment is installed, this blaster deals Fire damage instead of its normal damage type and deals an extra **1d6** Fire damage to any target it hits.

This barrel-mounted module emits sparks of lighting into the blaster's aperture. While it is installed, this blaster deals Lightning damage instead of its normal damage type and it gains the __Jolt__ mastery property in addition to its normal mastery property. You can only use one mastery property on each attack. You can use the __Jolt__ property of the blaster, even if you don't have the Weapon Mastery feature, and it doesn't count against the number of weapons you can use.

This arcane battery surges with magical energy. While it is installed, you have a +1 bonus to ranged attack and damage rolls made with this blaster, which is a magic weapon. The bonus is determined by the battery's rarity and doesn't apply to magic weapons that already have a bonus to attack and damage rolls.

This arcane battery surges with magical energy. While it is installed, you have a +2 bonus to ranged attack and damage rolls made with this blaster, which is a magic weapon. The bonus is determined by the battery's rarity and doesn't apply to magic weapons that already have a bonus to attack and damage rolls.

This arcane battery surges with magical energy. While it is installed, you have a +3 bonus to ranged attack and damage rolls made with this blaster, which is a magic weapon. The bonus is determined by the battery's rarity and doesn't apply to magic weapons that already have a bonus to attack and damage rolls.
The normal and long ranges of the blaster double.

The quantum electromagnet installed on the blaster allows you to use a Bonus Action to pull the blaster to your open hand if it is within 60 feet of you and isn't being carried. You can't be disarmed of the blaster unless you have the Incapacitated condition.

This external arcane battery overloads your blaster with a surge of energy. When you make a ranged attack with this blaster, you can choose to make an overcharged shot. Doing so causes the blaster to deal an extra **6d6** damage to the target on a hit. The blaster then Overheats; an overheated weapon can't be used again to make an attack until the end of your next turn. Once you use this mod, you can't use it again until the next dawn.

This composite alloy chassis reinforces the blaster against impacts and enables it to be used as a blunt implement. The weapon gains the __Bludgeon__ mastery property in addition to its normal mastery property, though you can only use one mastery property on each attack. You can use the __Bludgeon__ mastery property of the blaster, even if you don't have the Weapon Mastery feature, and it doesn't count against the number of weapons you can use.

Your Ranged weapon attacks using blasters ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover, if there exists a solid surface off of which to ricochet the shot towards the target. You can target a creature in Total Cover with a ricocheted ranged attack using this blaster with Disadvantage. As normal, if you're guessing the location of a creature in Total Cover and the creature isn't in the space you targeted, you miss.

This high-magnification scope improves the blaster's accuracy, at the cost of close quarters functionality. You don't have Disadvantage on ranged attacks using this weapon at long range. However, while this mod is installed, you have Disadvantage on ranged attacks using this weapon out to its normal range.

The hefty suppressor installed on this blaster causes attacks made with it to make only a low pew audible out to 10 feet. The light given off by the blaster is also masked, resulting in a flash at its point of impact, but no visible streak through the air.

This non-magnifying scope grants you Thermalsight out to the blaster's normal range while you are making attacks using this blaster. Your Thermalsight provided by this mod is limited to a narrow tunnel. As a result, you have Disadvantage on ability checks that rely on this Thermalsight.

The deck is a handheld device with a large screen that is connected to an extradimensional space. As a Utilize action, you can touch an object that isn't being worn or carried by another creature to the deck, teleporting it to the extradimensional space. The object must be less than 4 feet across in every dimension and weigh less than 150 pounds. The Deck of Holding can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet. Its inventory can be viewed on its screen. As a Utilize action while holding the deck, you can select any item stored within and teleport it to your hands or to an unoccupied space on the ground within 5 feet of you.
If the Deck of Holding is destroyed, its contents are scattered in the Astral Plane.

Placing the deck in an extradimensional space (such as one created by a Bag of Holding) instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate originates where one item was placed inside the other. Any creature within 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on the gate is sucked through it to a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes. The gate is one-way only and can't be reopened.
